part.text:
All tests pass. Summary of the fix in `src/parser.y`:

- `Pattern: '$' Keyword` — allows keywords as bindings in `as`, `reduce`, `foreach`, and destructuring patterns
- `Exp: "label" '$' Keyword '|' Exp` — allows `label $if | ...`
- `Term: BREAK '$' Keyword` — allows `break $if`
- `ObjPat: '$' Keyword` / `'$' Keyword ':' Pattern` and `MkDictPair: '$' Keyword ':' ExpD` — allows keyword bindings in object destructuring and object construction

`make check` passes all 7 test suites, including the new keyword-binding cases in tests/jq.test (tests/jq.test:1776-1794).
